analysis.reasonEn: Following the prior record, RSI's oversold entry showed slowing improvement. While the current price is 1.57% above SMA200, it fell below SMA5 ($1.31) and failed to break resistance ($1.39). MACD histogram improvement continues but remains negative. The weekly ADX at 25.4 indicates an early trend formation, but -DI (25.9) exceeds +DI (17.3), showing downward pressure dominance. The 4H RSI attempts a rebound at 46.0, but the lack of clear directional momentum on daily and weekly charts warrants a wait-and-see approach.

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): lack of clear direction, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
